title: Add S3 and GCS sinks for customer-managed audit log export (Private)
author: Dev Patel
description:
Implements customer-managed audit log export for Redwood Private by adding first-class S3 + GCS sinks, wiring configuration, and adding operational metrics/alerts.

Motivation
- Required for multiple Private deployments to pass security review (audit retention + customer SIEM ingestion).
- Captured via INT-883 and RFC PR #124.

What changed
- Implement S3Sink and GCSSink with shared batching/compression (JSONL + gzip)
- Add deterministic partitioning: tenant_id, cluster_id, date, part counter
- Add encryption controls:
  - S3: supports SSE-S3 and SSE-KMS (customer key ARN)
  - GCS: supports CMEK key name
- Auth:
  - AWS IRSA -> AssumeRole with ExternalId required
  - GCP Workload Identity Federation -> service account impersonation
- Add buffering and backpressure:
  - local disk queue with watermark and pause/resume for JetStream consumer
- Metrics:
  - audit_exporter_last_success_timestamp
  - audit_exporter_failed_put_total{reason=auth|perm|timeout|kms|other}
  - audit_exporter_buffer_bytes

Config
- Adds `auditLogExport` block consumed by redwood-private-installer and the exporter chart.

Changed areas (high level)
- pkg/sink/s3/*.go
- pkg/sink/gcs/*.go
- pkg/buffer/disk_queue.go
- charts/audit-log-exporter/values.yaml
- docs/private/audit-log-export.md

Snippets
- Object key format:
  `{{prefix}}/v1/tenant_id={{tenant}}/cluster_id={{cluster}}/date={{yyyy-mm-dd}}/part-{{000001}}.jsonl.gz`

Review conversation
Aisha Rahman: Please ensure we fail closed if ExternalId is not set. Customers will copy/paste examples; we need safe defaults.
Dev Patel: Done. `externalId` is required when sink=s3 and auth=assumeRole; exporter refuses to start otherwise.

Diego Fernandez: For Private, the source is JetStream; confirm pause/resume works and doesn't drop messages during backpressure.
Dev Patel: Added consumer pause + ack-on-success semantics; included a load test note in docs.

Connor OBrien: Can we avoid listing bucket contents? Some customers disallow ListBucket.
Dev Patel: S3 path no longer requires ListBucket; we only PutObject and AbortMultipartUpload.

CI
- unit tests pass
- integration tests: s3 localstack, gcs emulator

Rollout
- Feature flag `AUDIT_EXPORT_ENABLED` default false
- Design partner enablement tracked via INT-883

Outcome
Merged (squash).
release_notes: Private: Add export of audit logs to customer-owned S3/GCS with encryption + short-lived auth.
